headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 14, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the San Diego Padres took down the Baltimore Orioles 5-2, with Walker Buehler earning the win, and the Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners 10-1, led by James Wood's 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Carlos Estévez, who has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Kansas City Royals due to a left foot contusion. Other injured players include Michael Helman (Texas Rangers), Keaton Winn (San Francisco Giants), Freddy Fermin (San Diego Padres), José Ramírez (Cleveland Guardians), Vinnie Pasquantino (Kansas City Royals), Evan Carter (Texas Rangers), and Wilber Dotel (Pittsburgh Pirates).

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their roster, trading RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold. The Chicago Cubs acquired RHP Yosver Zulueta from the Seattle Mariners in exchange for cash, and the Chicago White Sox traded for RF Nolan Jones and cash from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for Future Considerations.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Max Meyer earning the win after 6.0 innings of work. Bryan Reynolds led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Padres Take Down Orioles 5-2**
top_news.summary: The San Diego Padres secured a 5-2 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Walker Buehler earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 1 ER, 0 BB, and 6 H. Rodolfo Durán led the Padres' offense with 2 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Nationals Rout Mariners 10-1**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dominated the Seattle Mariners, securing a 10-1 victory. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 8-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured an 8-3 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Camilo Doval earning the win in relief. José Caballero led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Royals Roster Update: Carlos Estévez Placed on 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Kansas City Royals right-handed pitcher Carlos Estévez has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left foot contusion.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Connor Seabold in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their roster, trading RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold.
